title: Timeout retry creates a duplicate charge
facts: One logical order is expected to produce at most one economic charge.
A payment attempt succeeds, but the caller times out before receiving the response.
An automatic retry follows the timeout.
Two successful charges and two receipt events appear for the same order.
The receipt team proposes suppressing duplicate emails by order ID.
Logs show a different idempotency key on each attempt.
The provider treats different idempotency keys as different operations.
availableProbes: trace the key derivation for both attempts
replay the timeout and retry in a local simulator
verify order, ledger, provider, and receipt invariants after the proposed repair
constraints: The agent may propose a change and tests but may not alter production state.
Email deduplication may contain notification noise but must not be called a payment repair.
The solver must separate facts, inferences, and unknowns.

counterfactual.changedFact: Both attempts use the same stable order-scoped key, but two provider charges still appear.
counterfactual.instruction: Re-run the causal navigation. The causal location must move toward provider enforcement or integration misuse; do not reuse the original B-point without new evidence.
